_method:
Per-investigation profiles + transparent relevance ranking.

Inputs : data/derived/runs_all.csv, data/derived/investigations.csv, data/curated/investigation_notes.json
Output : data/derived/investigation_profiles.json, data/derived/ranking.csv

Ranking (0-100) per environment = material + role + atmosphere + evidence.
  material   (0-35): what burned. Real habitat solids 35, solid emulator (BRE) 28, smoke from spacecraft
                     materials 25, liquid droplets 15, gas flames 10, dust/no fire 8.
                     Ground studies of flight data get 70% of the material score of what they analyze.
  role       (0-25): brief's fire-safety roles. Prevention / detection / suppression 25; fundamentals 8.
  atmosphere (0-25): how close the tested atmospheres come to the environment (computed from runs_all.csv;
                     see atm_spacecraft / atm_moon). Ground studies 0.
  evidence   (0-15): run-level rows in PSI tables (0-8) + publications listed in PSI (0-7).
Every component is reported, so the rank can be checked and re-weighted.
_generated_with: SI-assisted (Claude, Anthropic); reviewed by Team Blue Flame

profiles.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments - Burning Rate Emulator
profiles.pi: John L de Peter James Dennis G. Ris Sunderland Quintiere Stocker

notes.summary: A gas burner tuned to behave like burning solids (the Burning Rate Emulator), used to map when materials keep burning in still air, as a function of material properties.
notes.fuel_form: CH4/N2 and C2H4/N2 mixtures through porous circular burners, 25 and 50 mm in diameter.
notes.sensors: Heat flux sensor and burner surface temperature, plus flame imaging.
notes.fire_safety: PSI's record states the planned atmospheres included NASA exploration atmospheres: 14.7 psia at 21% O2, 10.2 psia at 26.5% O2 and 8.2 psia at 34% O2. It reports quasi-steady burning matching PMMA and nylon in microgravity without airflow in elevated-oxygen atmospheres, while the same flames at 21% O2 self-extinguished. That matters because stopping ventilation is a standard step in fighting a spacecraft fire.
notes.key_finding: In elevated oxygen, flames kept burning with no airflow; at 21% they went out on their own (PSI record, preliminary results).
notes.earth: Suggests NASA's cone calorimeter test (NASA-STD-6001 Test 2) can measure the properties that predict microgravity burning.
notes.src: PSI-20 record: Objectives, Research Impacts/Earth Benefits

profiles.title: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments / Cool Flames Investigation with Gases
profiles.pi: Dennis Peter Richard Forman P. B. L. Stocker Sunderland Axelbaum Williams

notes.summary: Cool diffusion flames from a spherical burner, both normal and inside-out, reaching the highest oxygen levels of any PSI microgravity test.
notes.fuel_form: Gaseous fuels from a spherical porous burner, normal and inverse. The objectives name propane, n-butane and n-pentane; the PSI run table lists butane, ethane and propane.
notes.sensors: Cameras including an intensified video camera, radiometers, photomultiplier tubes, thermocouples.
notes.fire_safety: Its normal flames are the only PSI tests inside the Moon Base box (33-39% O2 at 0.5 atm), but they are gas flames, not habitat materials. In inverse flames the high oxygen is the burner stream (up to 85% per the brief), not the room air.
notes.earth: Kinetics for ultra-lean, more efficient engines.
